SELECT a.id AS article_id, a.author_id, a.title, a.summary, a.cover_url, a.cover_color, a.read_minutes, a.duration_category, a.published_at, a.updated_at FROM articles a WHERE a.status = 'APPROVED' AND a.deleted = 0 AND ORDER BY CASE WHEN COALESCE(a.title, '') LIKE CONCAT(#{escapedKeyword}, '%') THEN 1 WHEN COALESCE(a.title, '') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{escapedKeyword}, '%') THEN 2 WHEN COALESCE(a.summary, '') LIKE CONCAT(#{escapedKeyword}, '%') THEN 3 WHEN COALESCE(a.summary, '') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{escapedKeyword}, '%') THEN 4 ELSE 5 END ASC, a.published_at DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
